description: Aquatic Connectivity Assessment and Prioritization Tool is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by North Atlantic Aquatic Connectivity Collaborative; University of Massachusetts Amherst; The Nature Conservancy. Users in the North Atlantic region, from Maine to West Virginia, can use this site to help them identify bridges and culverts that impede aquatic connectivity. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – Coastal, Flooding – General, Flooding – Rainfall-induced, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Water Quality. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Transportation and Mobility, Water Infrastructure – Drinking Water, Water Infrastructure – General, Water Infrastructure – Wastewater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
